questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: All professional athletes in this league are required to undergo mandatory health screenings annually. Conclusions: I. Athletes who do not undergo health screenings are not professional athletes in this league. II. Health screenings are only mandatory for professional athletes, not amateurs.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: All professional athletes in this league are required to undergo mandatory health screenings annually.

Conclusions: I. Athletes who do not undergo health screenings are not professional athletes in this league.

II. Health screenings are only mandatory for professional athletes, not amateurs.
questions.solution:
I. Athletes who do not undergo health screenings are not professional athletes in this league.→ True

The statement "All professional athletes in this league are required to undergo mandatory health screenings annually" is a conditional statement. It can be written as: If a person is a professional athlete in this league, then they must undergo health screenings

questions.question: Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option. Statement: Despite stringent safety protocols, the recent surge in automated vehicle accidents suggests that current sensor technology is inadequate for handling unpredictable urban environments. Assumptions: I. Sensor technology plays a crucial role in preventing automated vehicle accidents. II. Stringent safety protocols alone are insufficient to prevent all automated vehicle accidents. III. Automated vehicle accidents have increased primarily due to poor driver training.
questions.questionHtml:
Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.

Statement: Despite stringent safety protocols, the recent surge in automated vehicle accidents suggests that current sensor technology is inadequate for handling unpredictable urban environments.

Assumptions: I. Sensor technology plays a crucial role in preventing automated vehicle accidents.

II. Stringent safety protocols alone are insufficient to prevent all automated vehicle accidents.

III. Automated vehicle accidents have increased primarily due to poor driver training.

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
options.html: Only I and II are implicit

options.text: Only II and III are implicit
options.html: Only II and III are implicit

options.text: All I, II, and III are implicit
options.html: All I, II, and III are implicit

questions.solution:
Assumption I:

The statement blames inadequate sensor technology for the surge in accidents.This only makes sense if sensors are indeed crucial for preventing accidents.

Assumption II:

The statement begins with “Despite stringent safety protocols,” meaning safety protocols are in place but accidents still increased.This implies the protocols alone aren’t enough, which supports the conclusion about sensor inadequacy.
